title: macOS Traffic Light Button Overlap
symptom: Traffic lights overlap Folder button & KobeanAudio logo
root_cause: Tailwind sm:px-3 media query specificity override

title: Viewport Bottom Overlap & Cutoff
symptom: Editor footer and inspector bottom controls pushed under player dock
root_cause: Flexbox children default to min-height: auto without min-h-0

title: TopNav & Dock Dropdown Clipping
symptom: Dropdown menus in TopNav and AudioPlayer popovers cut off
root_cause: Parent container had overflow-hidden on fixed height header/dock

title: Scroll Container Bottom Cutoff
symptom: Bottom controls (Auto-Trim Silence, SQLite footer) touch bottom dock
root_cause: Scroll containers lacked bottom breathing room padding

title: Waveform Collapsing on Narrow Windows
symptom: Waveform canvas collapses to vertical oval when window shrinks

title: TopNav Right Popover Offscreen Overflow
symptom: Engine picker menu expands off the right screen edge on narrow screens
root_cause: Popovers on right side used absolute left-0 instead of right-0
